_comment: FIX (reproducibility, review item #9). Copy this file per optimizer run and fill it in — the notebooks write one of these automatically next to each candidate's exported instructions. Foundry's optimizer is a hosted, versioned, non-deterministic service; without this record a 'Run 1 vs Run 2' comparison cannot be attributed cleanly to optimizer search stochasticity vs. silent model-version drift vs. eval-time sampling noise.

outputs.composite_score_note: This is the Optimize wizard's own reported number, computed in-sample against dataset.file_uploaded (dataset/optimize.jsonl). It is NOT a holdout score and compare_to_foundry.py never treats it as one.
outputs.holdout_composite_score_note: Leave null until a response-level harness runs this exported candidate against dataset/holdout.jsonl and scores its real responses/tool calls with the shared score_response function (see _baselines/dspy_mipro/metric.py). That harness does not exist in this pack yet (docs/paper/paper-v3.md Sec 5.2/8) -- compare_to_foundry.py reports the gap explicitly rather than substituting composite_score.
